partners.name: Fuad Al Qudsi
partners.title: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist · FuadFit
partners.bio: Fuad, RDN, CPT, partners with Trainability on nutrition. He specializes in adult and older adult weight management, sports nutrition, and conditions linked to body weight, such as pre-diabetes, diabetes, high cholesterol and high blood pressure. Trainability members get a complimentary 30-minute consultation.
